title: Dense size of the quadratic system
statement: For every Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, the dense size of its associated homogeneous quadratic system is at most $(n+g+2)^3$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
